title: Siremis v4.0.0 Released
html:
Siremis, the web management interface, has released version 4.0.0, offering out of the box compatibility with Kamailio v4.0.x release series.

Read more details and links to installation guides at:

  • http://siremis.asipto.com/2013/05/08/siremis-v4-0-0-released/
